scope: Actual fresh managed Codex launches through the supported Rig launch_wrapper with these modules; native per-thread workspace policy controls and authenticated coding. Not WebMux creation/UI integration or recovery qualification.

Workspace policy comes from documented native per-thread overrides projected through the existing-account native observer; it is not qualification of selected configuration profiles or the owner default workspace-write configuration.

Current native evidence covers workspace-write with network false/true, explicit extra root and both temporary-root exclusions. Read-only/full-access and non-default service tier have unit controls, not actual native qualification of this wrapper.
No Linux/Windows wrapper, provider-loss, manager/host failure or reboot recovery qualification.
Observation startup integration and named/inherited permission graph limitations remain as documented by #508.
Failed, incomplete and source-unbound harness reports remain retained privately and are excluded from these positive cases.
